gen-gf-belleza-fs-literata: Friendly, close-knit lettering up top. Belleza is best at drawing the eye in with round, inviting shapes, while Literata, a text serif, does its work in sturdy, bookish lines.
gen-gf-benchnine-fs-literata: Literata brings a bookish, sturdy serif to the page. BenchNine sits above it, tight and quick for skimming, and the serif beneath slows things down with soft shifts that never turn stark.
gen-gf-bentham-fs-bespoke-sans: Editorial through and through. Bentham swings from hairline to bold in each letter, then Bespoke Sans keeps the paragraphs sharp and refined, with generous gaps where its curves meet the stems.
gen-gf-besley-fs-bespoke-sans: Besley leads with open curves and a faint charcoal-like pressure shadow. Under it, Bespoke Sans keeps a paragraph moving smoothly, since its strokes hardly vary and its curves leave generous space beside each stem.
gen-gf-bevan-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional and bookish, Bevan loops its c nearly shut and spaces its letters generously. And Bespoke Sans, with open curves and sharp, refined lines, lets that closed, pencil-soft heading stand out instead of competing.
gen-gf-biz-udgothic-fs-literata: BIZ UDGothic opens its counters wide, the s especially, giving the heading a clean, approachable face. Literata then carries a long read with tilted-nib verticals and a bookish, sophisticated serif voice.
gen-gf-biz-udpgothic-fs-literata: Sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones give this body a bookish, sophisticated feel. Literata keeps its curves wide open over a long page, while BIZ UDPGothic stays clean and contemporary above it.
gen-gf-biz-udpmincho-fs-bespoke-sans: BIZ UDPMincho strides across widely spaced letters with a soft step from heavy to light. Its literary looseness meets the sharp, refined precision of Bespoke Sans, and that gap between them is the pair's real appeal.
gen-gf-bona-nova-fs-bespoke-sans: Bona Nova is literary and dignified, its curves thickening gently at the shoulders. Bespoke Sans follows with refined, steady lines, so a long stretch of text moves along without any stroke pulling at the eye.
gen-gf-bona-nova-sc-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans is sharp and refined, leaving generous room between its curve ends and stems. Bona Nova SC does its best work in dignified, bookish capitals with a soft cadence, but the body is built for plain, steady reading.
